name: ai.bezal/local-commerce
title: Bezal — Local Business Intelligence for AI Agents
description: Search 7,000+ local service businesses across America by category, location, or keyword.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search local business profiles on Bezal by name, category, or location. Everyday words work too, so "tech help" finds IT Services and "plumber" finds Plumbing. A Connecticut county searches the towns in it. When a town or county has none of what was asked, the answer is a note and the closest ones within 30 miles, nearest first, each with distance_miles. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos, coordinates and a booking link (when the provider saved one) are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only for providers on a higher paid plan.

query.description: Free-text search across business name and category (3 characters or more)

county.description: County name, e.g. "Litchfield". Connecticut counties only so far. Ignored when city names a town.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get the public Bezal profile for one business by UUID. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos, coordinates and a booking link (when the provider saved one) are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only for providers on a higher paid plan. For services, use get_service_catalog.

id.description: The UUID of the business to look up

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all available business categories in the directory.

tools.name: search_by_service
tools.description: Find businesses that list a specific service, when you know the exact service rather than the category (for example "Drain cleaning" rather than "plumbing"). Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos, coordinates and a booking link (when the provider saved one) are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only for providers on a higher paid plan.

service_type.description: Exact service offered (matched against the services list)

location.description: Optional city or state to filter by

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Get reviews for a specific business: Bezal reviews (rating, text, verified flag, date and the reviewer as first name and last initial) plus the Google rating and review count.

tools.name: get_service_catalog
tools.description: Get services and pricing for a specific business. Falls back to the list of service names if no priced catalog exists.

tools.name: check_business_availability
tools.description: Check whether a business is open on a date, based on its posted opening hours. Hours are shared only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and other listings come back with open set to "unknown". It doesn't know about bookings, so confirm a time with the business.

tools.name: compare_businesses
tools.description: Compare up to 5 businesses side by side: the public profile fields plus services, BezalRank and whether the profile is claimed. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos, coordinates and a booking link (when the provider saved one) are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only for providers on a higher paid plan.

business_ids.description: Array of business UUIDs to compare

tools.name: search_by_city
tools.description: Search for businesses in a specific city, optionally filtered by category. When a category has none in the town or county, the answer is a note and the closest ones within 30 miles, nearest first, each with distance_miles. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos, coordinates and a booking link (when the provider saved one) are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only for providers on a higher paid plan.

city.description: City name, or a Connecticut county as in "Litchfield County"

state.description: Two-letter state code or full name
